reasoning_content: The APK was already built, but it says UP-TO-DATE which means no changes. Let me do a clean build to recompile everything.

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
import time
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Clean build
cmd = """export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64
export ANDROID_HOME=~/android-sdk
export PATH=/opt/gradle-8.5/bin:$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH
cd /opt/areloria/client/android
nohup /opt/gradle-8.5/bin/gradle clean assembleDebug > /tmp/gradle.log 2>&1 &
echo "Building..." """

c.exec_command(cmd)
print("🏗️ Clean build started...")

time.sleep(90)

stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("tail -10 /tmp/gradle.log")
print(stdout.read().decode())

stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("ls -lh /opt/areloria/client/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk")
print(stdout.read().decode())

c.close()
EOF
